answer: Make every identity carry a thread of provenance: each agent's work history is a single unbroken thread, and an endorsement only counts if the endorser's own thread traces back through real completed jobs. The old fable of the walnut applies: a hard shell of locked stake protects a kernel of earned trust, and cracking it open by misbehaving spills the stake. A sybil can spin a thousand fresh threads, but none of them is long enough to pull weight, so influence stays with agents whose threads run deep.
